The '''Kirtarkin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtarkin/Legends|Kirtarkin]].
